jobs.name: head-front
jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Request 30 developer head redraw. Input 1 protagonist isolated head: PRIMARY STYLE guide only. Input 2 writer head: second STYLE guide only. Input 3 approved developer full figures and portrait: IDENTITY and DESIGN authority. Render developer as a third character in the SAME animated film as images 1 and 2. Do not copy their identity, hair, mask or glasses. The unmasked portrait in image 3 establishes his face; this output uses his gaiter raised as on its full figures.
House style: polished animated-film 3D character render, matching protagonist and writer references. Simplified sculpted forms, clean facial planes, smooth skin with soft warm shading, clear slightly enlarged eyes, strong readable brows and nose, slightly exaggerated character proportions. Sculpted clumps and locks of hair with clear shapes. Cloth uses broad folds and painted wear. No pores, fine skin lines, individual flyaway strands, blemishes, textile weave, lens noise or photographic texture. Plain uniform mid-grey background and even warm soft studio light; no ground plane, cast shadows, text, labels, logos, emblems, brand marks or watermark.
Square 1024 x 1024. Only isolated head and bare neck, neck ends at clean horizontal graft cut. No shoulders, shirt, vest, collar, bust stand or torso. Muted green gaiter covers nose and mouth, wraps neck down to cut. Black rectangular glasses are a separate projecting 3D object with solid visible frames and temple arms. Preserve approved identity: heavyset middle-aged man, warm light skin, broad brow/nose, short curly greying brown hair, thinning crown as simple softly shaded scalp patch between sculpted curls. Same head size, eye-level camera height and lighting for every view; full silhouette fits within small margin.
Straight-on FRONT, centered, head level, gaze straight forward. Preserve his age and kind expression through broad simplified brow/eye shapes, not skin lines. Hair as deliberately shaped chunky curled locks with subtle grey sections at temples. Gaiter a smooth sculpted cloth form with large folds and flat muted green shading. Character finish and material simplicity must match image 1.

jobs.name: body-side
jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: high quality single-view body reference for Meshy. Input 1 accepted T-pose FRONT: exact proportions, materials, render quality and light. Input 2 approved character sheet: identity and clothing detail. Render exactly the SAME character rotated 90 degrees in the SAME pose, never a cutout or flattened composite. Do not reference prior side-view drafts.
House style: polished animated-film 3D character render, matching protagonist and writer references. Simplified sculpted forms, clean facial planes, smooth skin with soft warm shading, clear slightly enlarged eyes, strong readable brows and nose, slightly exaggerated character proportions. Sculpted clumps and locks of hair with clear shapes. Cloth uses broad folds and painted wear. No pores, fine skin lines, individual flyaway strands, blemishes, textile weave, lens noise or photographic texture. Plain uniform mid-grey background and even warm soft studio light; no ground plane, cast shadows, text, labels, logos, emblems, brand marks or watermark.
Same feminine writer: warm brown skin, round wire glasses with dark flip-up lenses raised, magenta bandana over nose/mouth and scarf tails on chest, worn knee-length open brown coat with once-rolled sleeves, grey sweater, slim dark trousers rolled at ankles and brown laced boots. Her hair is pinned entirely on head, off collar/shoulders/back, as on input 1.
Portrait 1024 x 1536. Strict true LEFT PROFILE, nose toward IMAGE LEFT. Full body remains in strict T-pose; arms horizontal in world space, palms down, fingers together, feet shoulder-width apart. Near left arm projects toward camera, foreshortened with fingers seen end-on at shoulder height; far arm overlaps behind. Body and face perfectly profile, no three-quarter cheat. Pack, pack straps, cables, cameras and poles entirely removed. Both boots, hair and foreshortened hand complete. Preserve rich dimensional modeling, coherent soft light and shadows on body like front; no outline, edge fringe, halo, vignette, paper cutout look. Render at full quality with ample surrounding grey. Match front framing if possible, but preserve sculpture/material quality above all; any camera scale adjustment will be done deterministically after generation, not by another generative edit.

jobs.name: body-side
jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: this new LEFT PROFILE T-posed body. Change ONLY a pose artifact: remove the far forearm/hand that visibly sticks horizontally from behind the back toward IMAGE RIGHT at shoulder height. In strict 90-degree profile the far arm points directly away from the camera and is COMPLETELY OCCLUDED behind the near arm and torso, so no far hand, forearm or sleeve projects outside the back silhouette. Fill the removed projection with the unchanged adjoining grey background. Keep the NEAR foreshortened arm and hand pointing straight TOWARD the viewer completely unchanged. Preserve the whole figure's position, scale, proportions, upright posture, feet, dimensional sculpture, coat/vest and folds, all colors/materials, lighting, background and portrait 1024 x 1536 framing. Do not shrink, reframe, rotate or flatten the figure. No other edits.
